bio: Set in the heart of Covent Garden, and just 50 yards back from the Piazza, Boulevard Brasserie is a Parisian style brasserie, offering a unique setting to enjoy Afternoon Tea in London.  Enjoy a choice of fine teas and coffees, accompanied by a selection of savouries, freshly baked scones with clotted cream and strawberry preserve and an assortment of homemade miniature cakes and tarts for just £24.95 per person.  Enjoy Afternoon Tea with bottomless Prosecco (1.5 hours) for just £34.95 per person.  The Brasserie is set across 3 floors and features French inspired interiors, offering a relaxed and cosy atmosphere.
